objective: To let the LP Admin of a trucking company confirm (accept / reject) the orders sent by the VPLD Planner through DTP Creation.
To assign a truck of the trucking company to each accepted order and change it when needed; the order follows the truck's license plate to the Driver app.
To keep an audit trail of every status and truck change.

buttons.name: Filters
buttons.function: Search, delivery date, statuses, license plate, sort, paging.

buttons.name: Reject
buttons.function: To reject the order with a reason (confirmation).

buttons.name: Assign
buttons.function: To link an available truck of the LP to an accepted order.

buttons.name: Change Truck
buttons.function: To replace the truck of an assigned order (confirmation).

buttons.name: View Detail
buttons.function: To show the order detail and audit trail.

operation.text: Calendar view of the current month; Order List view available by the toggle. LP Admin: orders of its trucking company only (TA-02).
Other users: view only, no action buttons (message no. 1).
One bar per date + DTP type: '(DTP n) {name} [ count ]'; click opens the assignment order list of that date and type.

items: Accept: confirmation no. 3 -> LP_STATUS ACCEPTED, audit, message no. 4. Blocked cases: no. 5.
Reject: Reject Order dialog with Reject Reason (>= 10 chars, no. 6) -> LP_STATUS REJECTED, reason, audit (no. 8). Not after Accept (no. 7).
The rejected order shows 'Rejected by LP' on the planner's calendar (Planning Order).
Picker lists the trucks of the order's LP with Truck Type, Truck Status for this order and Driver; Search License Plate; unavailable trucks disabled with the reason.
Checks on submit: registered (no. 15), same LP (no. 16), not maintenance (no. 17), license (no. 18), not busy same date + shift (no. 19), type (no. 20).
Save in one transaction: active assignment, order plate / driver, status Order Release, audit (no. 21). The driver logging in with this plate sees the order.
Only Order Release with truck, before Start Order (no. 22).
Picker shows the current truck and the replacement candidates (current excluded); different truck (no. 23); same availability checks; reason optional (TBD OP-05).
Confirmation no. 24; one transaction: old assignment ACTIVE_FLAG N, new assignment Y, order plate / driver, audit (no. 25).
The old plate no longer sees the order in the Driver app; the old truck is free again.

operation.text: Truck selection + selected orders; Accept / Assign / Change Truck / Reject run per order (TA-10): failures listed (no. 26); Assign one order at a time (no. 11); truck required (no. 9).

Filters: Search Order / DTP, Delivery Date From / To, Order Status, Assignment Status, License Plate; Clear. Default sort Delivery Date descending; header sort; 10 / 25 / 50 rows; Refresh. No match: no. 28.
Order detail and audit trail (date-time, action, order status prev -> new, plate prev -> new, reason / note, user).

rows: Orders come from the DTP queue (Daily order, Planning Order / DTP Creation Release)
LP Admin sees and acts only on its own trucking company; others view only
Order from DTP Creation must be Accepted before any truck link (also IELP Admin Assign / Order Release)
Reject: reason >= 10 chars, only before Accept and before a truck; no further assignment
Truck: same LP, not Maintenance, license valid on delivery date, not active same date + shift, type as ordered
Assign: plate + driver of the truck on the order, status Order Release, Driver app of that plate
One active assignment per order; second Assign not possible
Change Truck: Order Release, not started, different available truck; replaces the active assignment; confirmation
Audit for every action: statuses, plates, reason, user, date-time
Batch in the modal checked per order; failures listed; Assign one order at a time
Accept for the whole DTP or per order (mock-up: per order, batch selection)
Truck availability statuses; several orders per truck per day in different shifts
Truck type list and matching (COMBO for TRAILER order?)
Driver fixed per truck or chosen at assignment
Change Truck: reason mandatory? allowed after Start Order (breakdown)?
Rejected order: planner reassigns to another LP or creates a new DTP
Notifications to driver / planner after assign, change, reject
